# PicchuSpot — Real Estate Visual Services

PicchuSpot is an online real estate visual services studio. We help real estate
agents, photographers, property marketers, and agencies produce market-ready
property visuals through a streamlined online ordering system with fast delivery.

## Services

- Virtual Staging: Furnish empty or outdated rooms with realistic digital
  furniture and decor. 9 interior styles, delivered in 24–48 hours.
- Virtual Renovation: Show renovation potential with realistic visual updates
  for finishes, fixtures, flooring, kitchens, bathrooms, pools, and landscaping.
- Floor Plans: 2D and 3D floor plan redraws from sketches, scans, PDFs, or
  measurements. Listing-ready JPG and PDF delivery.
- Image Enhancement / Real Estate Photo Editing: Color correction, exposure
  balance, white balance, lens cleanup, and window view recovery for listing
  photos. From $2 per image.
- Item Removal & Virtual Cleaning: Remove clutter, personal items, and visual
  distractions from property photos for cleaner listing images.
- Day to Dusk: Transform daytime exterior photos into warm twilight-style
  listing images for stronger hero shots and premium presentation.
- 360° Image Enhancement: Color, exposure, and stitch cleanup for
  equirectangular panoramas used in virtual tours.
- 360° Virtual Staging: Stage furniture inside 360° panoramic room images so
  virtual tours show furnished, lived-in spaces.
- Aerial Editing: Enhance drone and aerial property visuals for cleaner land,
  exterior, neighborhood, and listing presentation.
- Development Site Plans: Visual site plans for land, development, subdivision,
  multi-unit, and project presentation.

## Audience

Real estate agents, real estate photographers, property marketers, and real
estate agencies seeking professional property visuals produced remotely with
fast turnaround times.

## Delivery

Many standard digital orders are delivered within 24 to 48 hours after files
and instructions are received. Complex or custom work may take longer.
